answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the nebula check immediately, the vine audit keeps the resolved set and the comet replay publishes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 256 aliases thus pays the reading cost 256 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
